name: GET /api/auth/sso/:provider/callback - provider redirect target
description: Public, called by the provider. Checks state against the signed cookie, exchanges the code with the PKCE verifier, verifies the ID token (signature via JWKS, issuer, audience, expiry, nonce) and resolves the account: a linked identity (provider + subject) first, else an existing active account whose email the provider verified (Google email_verified, Microsoft xms_edov). SSO never creates accounts. Always answers 302: to /sso/complete#code=<one-time code> on success, or /login?sso_error=<cancelled|state_mismatch|provider_error|email_unverified|no_account>. Covers: a user can sign in with Google or Microsoft SSO.

testCases.name: Missing state cookie redirects to sign-in with state_mismatch

environmentNote: Needs a live provider authorization code and the matching state cookie from /start. The success case passes only where SSO_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET are set; elsewhere the route returns 404 SSO_PROVIDER_DISABLED.
